Embed Pi operation MCP extension

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: FWN-69
  description: |-
    Embed the repository-owned TypeScript extension in codeoo-agent-pi and materialize it with restrictive permissions for explicit Pi loading.
    
    Discover the capability-scoped MCP catalog at session startup, register server-defined schemas, proxy bounded tool calls with exact activation retries, redact bootstrap values, and clear short-lived environment variables before child tools can inherit them.
    
    Cover fake Streamable HTTP behavior, collisions, cancellation, retry and error semantics, secret non-inheritance, cleanup, and loading by the reviewed real Pi executable.
